current.purpose: Cumulative synthetic generation challenges with independent expected outputs
current.nextGate: Representative application pilot and approved visual baselines; deepen advanced structure coverage.
current.docx: Scalar/image replacement, repeated rows and blocks, nested scopes and item images.
current.xlsx: Typed cells, multi-row blocks, contained merges, repeated pictures and bounded formulas.
current.standalone: One image, tenant keys, immutable template versions and durable jobs.
current.newFormatScope: 400 adapter regression cases and 12 selected PDF text comparisons; not every future band below is implemented.

phases.name: Independent oracle and renderer integration
deliverables: Integrate the Imprint Doc Gen renderer and record actual outputs without reference-file access
Office application repair/open checks and full schema checks with an independent toolchain
Render PDF previews with pinned fonts and converter versions; approve visual baselines
Record per-case render duration, peak memory and output size on named hardware
Run deterministic alternate ZIP/namespace/fragmentation seeds with identical semantic outputs
Add adversarial input variants: empty lists, missing/null fields, false/zero, longer Unicode values and unsupported expressions

phases.name: Expand DOCX and XLSX coverage beyond v1
deliverables: DOCX: merged/nested tables, numbering, footnotes/endnotes, comments, tracked changes, text boxes, anchored/cropped/rotated pictures, charts, alternate content and RTL

XLSX: dates and 1900/1904 epochs, merged cells intersecting repeats, shared/array/dynamic formulas, charts and pivots, hidden sheets, print areas, external-link preservation and drawings that move with inserted rows
Images: JPEG/PNG/SVG, EXIF orientation, transparency, missing attachments, unusual aspect ratios, contain/cover and replacement without changing unbound shared media
Add minimized and anonymized real-world Word, Excel, LibreOffice and Google-exported fixtures

acceptance: separate PDF/A or PDF/UA validator where claimed

phases.name: Legacy and specialist formats
phases.status: Adapter feasibility and support policy first; no support promise

separateRejectionSuite.status: Implemented for current bounded adapters; expand with each new format feature
separateRejectionSuite.success: Typed actionable error within resource limits; never mixed with valid-document generation score

releaseGates: All previously supported levels remain passing
Report gaps per format and feature; do not average away image failures
Record highest contiguous level alongside total passed and not-run
Separate fixture validity, engine semantics, visual fidelity and resource budgets
Promote only reviewed goldens; never update them automatically to match failing renderer output
